### Warby Parker Opens Preorders for First Intelligent Eyewear Collection


November 12, 2026


*The brand reveals all three styles in its first Intelligent EyewearTM collection, pairing signature design and prescription expertise with remarkable technology that opens up new ways to explore, learn, and discover.*


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Warby Parker Inc. (NYSE: WRBY), a lifestyle brand focused on vision for all, today unveiled its full Intelligent EyewearTM collection: three frame styles—Alden, Reid, and Wren—built in partnership with Google and Samsung. Available for preorder starting today, the collection starts at $395, with deliveries expected starting mid-December. Customers can explore all three styles at warbyparker.com and book an appointment to demo Intelligent Eyewear at any Warby Parker store in the U.S.


Warby Parker's Intelligent Eyewear collection


For more than 16 years, Warby Parker has helped people see more clearly. With Intelligent Eyewear, the company is now helping people experience the world in entirely new ways.


“Glasses are one of the most personal things we wear,” said Dave Gilboa, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of Warby Parker. “Intelligent Eyewear is about adding extraordinary capability without losing the beauty, simplicity, and humanity that make a great pair of glasses feel like part of you. By designing products that are as useful and intuitive as they are refined, we’re empowering people to look up, stay present, and engage more deeply with the world around them.”


**Designed for everyday wear**


The full Intelligent Eyewear collection features three frame styles—Alden, Reid, and Wren—inspired by Warby Parker’s most recognizable and beloved silhouettes. At about 41 grams, the frames bring together lightweight comfort and integrated technology, designed for all-day, everyday wear.


Each frame is crafted from ultra-lightweight, flexible nylon, with a semi-transparent finish on the inner temple that subtly reveals and celebrates the integrated technology and hardware. The styles are available in optical and sun versions across three colorways: Pine, Saddle, and Jet Black. The collection supports a wide range of prescriptions, widths, and lens options so that everyone can find their perfect fit. For additional versatility, customers can also select from a variety of custom clip-on sun lenses designed exclusively for Intelligent Eyewear.


Every pair reflects a design approach that starts first and foremost with the glasses themselves, driven by the belief that they must be something people want to wear all day. Warby Parker’s in-house, New York City-based design team focused on timeless style, lightweight comfort, and prescription compatibility, working closely with Google and Samsung to ensure that integrating the technology would not compromise style, fit, or comfort.


“Designing Intelligent Eyewear began with the same conviction that guides every collection we create: glasses should be as expressive as they are effortless to wear,” said Neil Blumenthal, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of Warby Parker. “We considered every detail, from the proportion of each silhouette to the interplay of color, material, and finish, with the same attention to fit, comfort, and optical quality that defines Warby Parker. The result is a collection that feels distinctly ours, with technology thoughtfully integrated to open up remarkable possibilities.”


**Intelligence for everyday life**


With Google Gemini, Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear brings contextual, in-the-moment assistance into everyday life, helping wearers access information and get things done while staying engaged with the world around them. The technology is designed to be useful when you need it and unobtrusive when you don’t.


Combined with Samsung’s engineering expertise, the frames feature a 12-megapixel HDR camera designed to capture high-quality photo and video, two open-ear speakers, and four microphones for voice input and audio capture. Intelligent Eyewear also delivers up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge, with a charging case that can recharge your frames up to seven times.


Intelligent Eyewear has privacy features designed for both sides of the lens. Google and Samsung developed hardware and software controls that put the wearer in charge, plus privacy protections for both wearers and bystanders. Learn more about Intelligent Eyewear privacy features on the[Google Safety Center](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fblog.google%2Finnovation-and-ai%2Ftechnology%2Fsafety-security%2Fintelligent-eyewear-privacy-protections&esheet=54640004&newsitemid=20261112472878&lan=en-US&anchor=Google+Safety+Center&index=1&md5=29bd7123ea4b72917f1512c57f0eb168) .


**Made to experience**


The full collection is available to explore at[warbyparker.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwarbyparker.com&esheet=54640004&newsitemid=20261112472878&lan=en-US&anchor=warbyparker.com&index=2&md5=c30291cb2a55f4ea0a9dea8e2ef0b7d6) , and customers can sign up for a guided demo experience at Warby Parker retail locations. Customers can experience the glasses firsthand in more than 60 U.S. stores starting today, before demos expand across the full fleet of more than 360 locations next week.


Also starting today, customers can visit Literatureland—an interactive space at 666 Broadway, on the corner of Bond Street in New York City, celebrating the launch of Intelligent Eyewear. Inspired by the brand’s literary heritage, Literatureland brings the printed page—and the places it can take us—to life. Visitors can explore the space and experience Intelligent Eyewear firsthand through guided demos.


To explore the collection, preorder Intelligent Eyewear, or book a guided demo, visit[warbyparker.com/intelligent-eyewear](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwarbyparker.com%2Fintelligent-eyewear&esheet=54640004&newsitemid=20261112472878&lan=en-US&anchor=warbyparker.com%2Fintelligent-eyewear&index=3&md5=547c57ae0c23c2fcd1a6010c453d825c) .


**FAQ**


**How much do the frames cost?**


Intelligent Eyewear frames start at $395.


**What frame widths are available?**


The collection features frames in medium and wide widths.


**What prescription lenses and lens options can I get with my Intelligent Eyewear?**


All of Warby Parker's core optical and sun lens offerings are available with Intelligent Eyewear. You can customize your frames with single-vision, progressive, precision progressive, readers, and blue-light-filtering lenses. We also offer 1.67 high-index lenses for stronger prescriptions, light-responsive (signature and XTRActive), anti-fatigue lenses, and fully custom polarized or tinted prescription sun lenses.


Our Intelligent Eyewear frames can support the following prescriptions:


- Polycarbonate: +4 to -8
- High-index 1.67: +5 to -8
- High-index 1.74: Not offered


**What is the battery life?**


Intelligent Eyewear delivers up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge, with a charging case that can recharge your frames up to seven times.


**What are the camera and video specs? What is the storage capacity?**


Our Intelligent Eyewear frames feature a 12-megapixel, ultra-wide camera designed to capture high-quality photos and videos. The camera is designed to capture your perspective with a 103-degree field of view in a 3:4 filming orientation.


The frames also come equipped with 64 GB of built-in flash storage. This provides plenty of space to capture your day without constantly needing to clear space.


**Tell me more about the clip-ons.**


- First up is the Windsor construction clip-on, which introduces a tortoise option to the assortment. Priced at $85, the Windsor features Oak Barrel paired with Riesling, bringing warmth and a stylish finishing touch to the frame.
- Our second clip-on construction is a lightweight stainless steel design, priced at $75. These are 4 grams lighter than our core metal clip-ons, helping minimize added weight while giving customers even more versatility.


**How much do the frames weigh?**


Our frames weigh about 41 grams.


**Will Intelligent Eyewear frame sales count toward Warby Parker’s Buy a Pair, Give a Pair program?**


Yes, Intelligent Eyewear purchases will count toward our Buy a Pair, Give a Pair program. The program will continue to support communities in need by helping provide access to glasses and vision care.


To learn more about Intelligent Eyewear, visit[warbyparker.com/intelligent-eyewear](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwarbyparker.com%2Fintelligent-eyewear&esheet=54640004&newsitemid=20261112472878&lan=en-US&anchor=warbyparker.com%2Fintelligent-eyewear&index=4&md5=896d36b75cf078a498ef295f893f2ba4) .
